findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_stores, create_store, get_repo · Private data: seller_setup, get_store, set_payout_wallets, create_payout_wallet, create_store, get_traffic, get_stats · Public sink: update_store · Destructive: delete_store.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_stores, create_store, get_repo · Private data: seller_setup, get_store, set_payout_wallets, create_payout_wallet, create_store, get_traffic, get_stats · Public sink: update_store · Destructive: delete_store

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
